title: UI/UX & Graphic Design Intern
description:
Collaborate with the design team to create visually appealing and user-friendly designs. 
 Develop high-quality graphics, illustrations, and visual elements for various projects. 
 Assist in designing and developing website layouts, mobile applications, and other digital products. 
 Conduct research to stay updated on the latest design trends and technologies. 
 Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate new design concepts. 
 Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements into the final product.
